post.summary: Starts an external phone call
post.description:
Registers the start of an external phone call from a third-party VoIP provider.
The body is a flat JSON object — field names are case-sensitive. See the Swagger
"Try it out" panel for a copy-pasteable example payload.
            
### Field notes
            
- **ProviderName** — identifies the integration name (phone vendor name).
- **ProviderId** — your stable identifier for the call. Used together with
  ProviderName for idempotent retries — replaying the same Start payload returns
  the existing call's Id rather than creating a duplicate row.
- **Direction** — `"Inbound"` or `"Outbound"`. Defaults to `Inbound` when omitted.
- **CallStatus** — initial call state at the start of the call.
- **StartCallDTM** — ISO-8601 timestamp when the call began.
- **CallerNumber / CallerName** — the calling party. Location fields
  (`CallerCity`, `CallerState`, `CallerZip`, `CallerCountry`) are optional.
- **CalleeNumber** — the dialed/destination number. For outbound calls Lead Docket
  uses this to match the row to an existing Lead by phone number.
- **ReferrerUrl** — landing page that initiated the call, if known.
            
Recording and transcript fields are documented on the matching EndCall operation —
they typically aren't available at call start.
            
### Marketing / attribution fields
            
Accepted on both StartCall and EndCall 
- **utm_source / utm_medium / utm_term / utm_content / utm_campaign** — standard UTM
  parameters. Land in the UTM query string on the call record.
- **medium** — accepted as a fallback for `utm_medium` only (used when `utm_medium`
  is empty).
- **ga** — Google Analytics client id. Populates `ClientId`.
- **gclid / fbclid / msclkid** — click-tracking ids. Populate `ClickId`
  (first non-empty wins).
- **keywords** — populates `Keywords`.
- **campaign** — populates `Campaign` (falls back to `utm_campaign` when absent).
- **CurrentUrl** — landing page / current URL. Populates `CurrentUrl`.

post.summary: Ends an external phone call
post.description:
Registers the completion of an external phone call from a third-party VoIP provider.
The body is a flat JSON object — field names are case-sensitive. See the Swagger
"Try it out" panel for a copy-pasteable example payload.
            
### Field notes
            
All StartCall fields are accepted on EndCall too. Additional fields typically only
known at call completion:
            
- **EndCallDTM** — ISO-8601 timestamp when the call ended.
- **DurationSeconds** — integer seconds the call lasted.
- **CallStatus** — final call state (e.g. `"completed"`, `"no-answer"`).
- **RecordingUrl** — publicly reachable URL to the recording media. Lead Docket
  attempts to download and store it in customer blob storage. If the URL is
  unreachable, returns a non-audio Content-Type, or exceeds the 250 MB cap, the
  original URL is preserved on the call record so the UI can render a click-out
  link instead of an embedded player.
- **TranscriptionText** — full call transcript text. Stored to blob and exposed via
  `GET /api/external-calls/{id}/transcription`. Transcripts only arrive via this
  EndCall body — there is no separate transcript-upload endpoint; if the
  transcription pipeline produces text later, replay EndCall with the field
  populated (the call is identified by ProviderName + ProviderId). The
  `TranscriptionText` value alone is capped at 5 MB; larger values are rejected with
  a 400 and no row is inserted or updated.
- **CallSummary** — short human-readable summary of the call. Silently truncated
  at 64 KB on ingestion.
            
Marketing / attribution fields (`utm_*`, `gclid`, `landing_page_url`, etc.) are
accepted on this endpoint too — see the StartCall remarks for the full list and
bucketing rules. Whatever wasn't known at StartCall time can be supplied here.

parameters.description:
Bitwise flags indicating which related entities to include.
Please opt into the specific details you require.
Possible values (combine using bitwise OR):
            
| Flag                                      | Description
|-------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------
| Sources                                   | Include lead source information.
| SeverityLevel                             | Include severity level information.
| PhoneCalls                                | Include phone call information.
| Office                                    | Include office information.
| Opportunity                               | Include opportunity information.
| Creator                                   | Include lead creator information.
| ReferredTo                                | Include referred to contact information.
| ReferredBy                                | Include referred by contact information.
| LeadStatusHistory                         | Include lead status history.
| RelatedContacts                           | Include related contacts.
| ContactCustomFields                       | Include contact custom fields.
| LeadCustomFields                          | Include lead custom fields.
| LeadNotes                                 | Include lead notes.
| Tasks                                     | Include tasks.
| Messages                                  | Include messages.
| LeadFiles                                 | Include lead files.
| EsignDocuments                            | Include esign documents.
| Settlements                               | Include settlements.
| CollectionSectionEntries                  | Include collection section entries.
